author: whiskash
quote: The storyline makes me facepalm. Lucia is pretty much a manupulative, loud-mouthed basic b**** that hides the existence of their child from Jason for a year or so and only tells him about it because she needs a place to parole. Jason like a good old boy asks no questions, demands no explanations but readily let's her back into his life, rubbing her feet and running errands for her. Like  wtf is wrong with you bruh! Girl has no redeming qualities in the world except the jiggle potential but you still have to partner partner up with your lowlife "girlfriend" because game gives you no choice. Feels like the real mocking target here is the player.
